title: ExecutionEnvironment: Test harness suites
description:
Implement ExecutionEnvironment test harness from docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add01-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Key deliverables:
- Property tests: interface completeness, state machine consistency, tool execution determinism, capabilities static, local provider parity
- Fault injection: API failures, session creation failures, mid-execution failures, RPC failures
- Oracle/golden tests: wire format verification, type mapping
- Contract compliance suite run against LocalEnvironment and NativeSandboxEnvironment
- Benchmarks: selection latency, adapter overhead, capability check, type conversion
- Stress tests: concurrent lifecycle, concurrent execution, rapid switching, session limit enforcement
- Security tests: session ID validation, parameter sanitization
- CI tier mapping

Depends on: T1 + T2 (both environments must exist)

AC: Full harness passes for LocalEnvironment and NativeSandboxEnvironment, CI tiers defined.
